item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The night sky: Moon and calendars
item.stem:
Rekha's grandfather says people once set their calendar by watching the sky. They matched day, lunar month, and year to cycles of the Sun, the Moon's phases, Earth's journey around the Sun, and the stars.

Which matching of time unit to sky cycle is correct?

options.A: A day follows the Moon's phases; a lunar month follows the Sun's daily path; a year follows the stars alone.
options.B: A day follows the Sun's apparent daily cycle; a lunar month follows the Moon's phase cycle; a year follows Earth's journey around the Sun.
options.C: Day, month, and year are only calendar words and are not tied to any sky cycle.
options.D: A day follows Earth's journey around the Sun; a lunar month follows the Sun's daily cycle; a year follows the Moon's phases.
